title: BNCI 2025-001 Motor Kinematics Reaching dataset
description: EEG recordings from 20 healthy participants performing a discrete center-out reaching task in four directions (up, down, left, right) at two speeds (slow, fast) and two distances (near, far). The data were recorded with 67 channels, including EOG, and preprocessed with eye artifact correction (SGEYESUB) and ICA. The dataset supports research on low-frequency EEG encoding of reaching kinematics and on brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp amplifier at 500 Hz using an ELPOS cap with 67 channels and a 50 Hz notch filter. Participants followed a visual cue with their eyes and then performed self-paced reaching movements with the right arm, for 960 trials over 10 blocks. Preprocessing included band-pass filtering at 0.3-80 Hz, SGEYESUB eye artifact correction, FastICA with IClabel-based component removal, common average referencing, and bad trial rejection.
